g:Before an action, can indicate that it is in progress; after 住, indicates location.

sections.translation: There are three bears living together: Father Bear, Mother Bear, and Baby Bear. Father Bear is plump. Mother Bear is thin. Baby Bear is very cute, growing up day by day.

sections.translation: There are three bears living together: Father Bear, Mother Bear, and Baby Bear. Father Bear is plump. Mother Bear is thin. Baby Bear is very cute, growing up day by day.

熊爸爸胖胖的: xióng bà ba pàng pàng de
熊妈妈瘦瘦的: xióng mā ma shòu shòu de
熊宝宝非常可爱: xióng bǎo bao fēi cháng kě ài
一天一天在长大: yì tiān yì tiān zài zhǎng dà
